rs-joint-m12-development.title: Which trip and shopping settings work better?
rs-joint-m12-development.intro: Six choices play the same starting cases. We compare the existing rules with the new shopper and return policy, then vary supply planning and return timing. All rows use the same milestone-12 Rust Borg code.

rs-joint-m12-confirm.title: Fresh-seed check: new shopping and trip policies
rs-joint-m12-confirm.intro: Does the locally selected supply setting reduce deaths on 1,800 fresh starting cases? Compare the existing rules, the new policies with ordinary provisioning, and the new policies planning for twice the risk. All rows use the same milestone-12 Rust Borg code.

rs-kit-trip-development.title: Expanded inventory and all-item returns: which settings work better?
rs-kit-trip-development.intro: Seven choices play the same 1800 starts. The new inventory model covers ammunition, oil, devices, books, food, mushrooms and equipment. Compare its default priorities with five variations and the existing rules.

rs-kit-trip-confirm.title: Fresh-case confirmation: expanded inventory and all-item returns
rs-kit-trip-confirm.intro: Does the integrated default policy reduce deaths on 1800 fresh starts? Both the expanded inventory model and the all-item learning-return rule act together. The comparison candidate was fixed before the development results.
